common_complete_contracts.meaning: Generic compile optionally skips absent optional files; otherwise clears class DATA, sequentially parses/validates/registers each section, then calls final validation/text collector, then class save. No preflight/rollback of earlier registrations or text baseline changes. Dedicated form/trainer/metadata/facility paths keep their separate source order. Earlier compile failure in compile_pbs_files stops subsequent domain producers and compile_all message gather/save.

Each listed producer invokes MessageTypes set/addMessagesAsHash, which load default baselines and writes only default-game[type]. set starts a new hash; add uses prior game hash. It skips nil candidates, normalizes each text key and excludes keys already present in default-core same domain, irrespective of translated value. Later eligible candidate at a normalized key wins. Empty string is truthy here and may be inserted if core lacks empty key; exporter later skips an empty original value. These APIs do not change selected-language current game/core stores.

compile_all(true) compiles PBS/animations/trainer events then gathers script/common/map text then saves default core and game sequentially by wb+Marshal.dump, then invokes cached default loading if core file exists. Cached truthy default-core, including [], returns before disk reading. No current-language reload is performed. A source-name producer call therefore does not establish which final .dat serialized keys exist, nor immediate selected-language display update. Core write may succeed before game failure; dump failure can leave partial/truncated file.

Trainer_LoadAndNew.pbConvertTrainerData collects TrainerType.real_name and setMessagesAsHash(TRAINER_TYPE_NAMES), then writes trainer-types PBS and trainers PBS. It is a source path separate from startup PBS final validators. Source file already full read in creature-save-events-contribution.json; it does not call save_default_messages or selected-language reload itself.
